mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an aggressive monetary easing that stimulates economic growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate below 6% signals a tight labor market that drives wage growth and boosts consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the unemployment rate is below 6% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals a strong supply environment that supports economic growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between strong GDP growth and low unemployment rates signals a robust demand environment that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth and low unemployment rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a decline in the federal funds rate and an increase in the consumer price index signals an inflationary environment that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of declining federal funds rate and rising consumer price index (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in payroll employment signals a strong labor market that drives wage growth and boosts consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when payroll employment is above 140000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts signals a weak demand environment that reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when housing starts are below 1200 (t-test p > 0.05).
